cards.ex: I think I'm coming down with a cold; I feel terrible.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, shamollayapman; o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir kasallik bilan og'rib qolish, kasal bo'lish.

cards.ex: After a week of rest, I'm fighting fit and ready to work.
cards.exUz: Bir hafta dam olganimdan so'ng, men juda sog'lomman va ishlashga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va kuchli, kasallikka qarshi kurasha oladigan holatda.

cards.ex: The doctor gave me a clean bill of health after the check-up.
cards.exUz: Shifokor tekshiruvdan so'ng menga sog'lom degan xulosani berdi.
cards.uzDef: Doktor tekshiruvidan so'ng sog'lom degan xulosa olish.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'll stay home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz xasta his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, kasalmandlik holati.

cards.ex: She's been ill, but she's on the mend now.
cards.exUz: U kasal edi, lekin hozir tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan so'ng asta-sekin yaxshilanib borish.

cards.ex: I've got a splitting headache; I need some medicine.
cards.exUz: Mening qattiq bosh og'rig'im bor; menga dori kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va og'riqli bosh og'rig'i.

cards.ex: My arthritis tends to flare up in cold weather.
cards.exUz: Mening artritim sovuq havoda kuchayib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki og'riq birdan kuchayib ketishi.

cards.ex: The new medicine was a real shot in the arm for his recovery.
cards.exUz: Yangi dori uning tuzalishiga katta yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yaxshilashga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: We need to nip this illness in the bud before it spreads.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kasallik tarqalishidan oldin uni ildizidan yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni boshlanishida bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: My grandfather is 80 years old, but he's as fit as a fiddle.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 80 yoshda, lekin u chinni kabi sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va kuchli holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm taking it easy; it's doctor's orders.
cards.exUz: Men oson qabul qilyapman; bu shifokorning buyrug'i.
cards.uzDef: Shifokorning tavsiyalari yoki buyruqlari.

cards.ex: His health is on its last legs after the long illness.
cards.exUz: Uzoq kasallikdan so'ng uning sog'lig'i oxirgi nafasida.
cards.uzDef: O'zining tugashiga yaqin, juda yomon holatda.

cards.ex: I need a dose of medicine to help me sleep.
cards.exUz: Menga uxlashga yordam beradigan bir doza dori kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ma'lum miqdori, odatda dori.

cards.ex: It takes time to get over the flu completely.
cards.exUz: Gripdan to'liq tuzalish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki yoqimsiz hodisadan tuzalib ketish.

cards.ex: I've been feeling run-down lately; I need a vacation.
cards.exUz: So'nggi paytlarda o'zimni holsiz his qilyapman; menga ta'til kerak.
cards.uzDef: Holsiz va charchagan, sog'lig'i yomonlashgan.

cards.ex: This new painkiller works like a charm; I feel much better.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi og'riq qoldiruvchi mo'jiza kabi ishlaydi; o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi va muvaffaqiyatli ishlash.

cards.ex: His heart attack was a wake-up call to start eating healthier.
cards.exUz: Uning yurak xuruji sog'lom ovqatlanishni boshlash uchun ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf haqida ogohlantiradigan voqea yoki tajriba.

cards.ex: I'm going to get a second opinion before I agree to the surgery.
cards.exUz: Men operatsiyaga rozi bo'lishimdan oldin ikkinchi fikr olaman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa shifokordan maslahat olish.

cards.ex: It's important to take care of your mental health as well as your physical health.
cards.exUz: Fizikaviy sog'lig'ingiz bilan bir qatorda ruhiy salomatligingizga ham g'amxo'rlik qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Insonning hissiy, psixologik va ijtimoiy holati.

cards.ex: She focuses on clean eating to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
cards.exUz: U sog'lom turmush tarzini saqlash uchun toza ovqatlanishga e'tibor qaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Qayta ishlanmagan, tabiiy mahsulotlarni iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: You look tired; you should get some rest.
cards.exUz: Siz charchaganga o'xshaysiz; siz dam olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish va kuch yig'ish.

cards.ex: It's difficult to kick the smoking habit, but it's possible.
cards.exUz: Chekish odatidan voz kechish qiyin, ammo bu mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatdan butunlay voz kechish.

cards.ex: He's attending pain management therapy to cope with chronic pain.
cards.exUz: U surunkali og'riqqa bardosh berish uchun og'riqni boshqarish terapiyasida qatnashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Og'riqni kamaytirish yoki yo'qotish uchun usullar.

cards.ex: His preexisting condition affected his insurance coverage.
cards.exUz: Uning mavjud holati sug'urta qoplamasiga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sug'urta boshlanishidan oldin mavjud bo'lgan tibbiy holat.

cards.ex: The stress of the job started to take its toll on her health.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yomon ta'sir ko'rsatish, zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: She's very resilient and always bounces back quickly.
cards.exUz: U juda chidamli va har doim tezda tiklanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda kasallikdan yoki muammodan tiklanish.

cards.ex: Eating healthy foods helps build up your immunity.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlar yeyish immunitetingizni oshirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kasalliklarga qarshi immunitetni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: I have a yearly check-up to make sure I'm healthy.
cards.exUz: Men sog'lig'imni tekshirish uchun har yili tekshiruvdan o'taman.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'ni tekshirish uchun shifokorga borish.

cards.ex: It's important to stay hydrated, especially in hot weather.
cards.exUz: Ayniqsa, issiq havoda namlikni saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tanani yetarli darajada suv bilan ta'minlash.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get into shape by going to the gym regularly.
cards.exUz: Men sport zaliga muntazam borib shaklga kirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar orqali yaxshi holatga kelish.
